defs.def: a series of images, events and feelings that happen in your mind while you are asleep 梦；睡梦

ex.s: The dream felt so authoritative that it shook me.
ex.t: 这个梦感觉如此权威，震撼了我。

ex.s: That dream reminded me that those fears and desires could encourage me to take risks and make experiments.
ex.t: 那个梦提醒我，那些恐惧和欲望可以鼓励我去冒险和尝试。

ex.s: Dreams are the reflections of realities.
ex.t: 梦境是现实的反映。

ex.s: The night before my marathon, I dreamt that I couldn’t even find the finish line.
ex.t: 在我参加马拉松的前一晚，我梦见自己甚至找不到终点线。

ex.s: It was the music event of his dreams.
ex.t: 那是他梦寐以求的音乐盛事。

ex.s: It was the music event of his dreams.
ex.t: 那是他梦寐以求的音乐盛事。

ex.s: The cars that drove the American Dream have helped to create a global ecological disaster.
ex.t: 那些推动了“美国梦”的汽车，却助长了一场全球生态灾难。

ex.s: One night, in my early 40s, I dreamed that a big woman in red approached me, handed me a bag of paints, and told me to start painting.
ex.t: 在我40岁出头的一个夜晚，我梦见一个穿红衣的高大女人走近我，递给我一袋颜料，让我开始画画。

ex.s: Which word would best describe the author’s dream?
ex.t: 哪个词最能描述作者的梦？

defs.def: a wish to have or be sth, especially one that seems difficult to achieve 梦想；理想；愿望

ex.s: It made her childhood dream come true.
ex.t: 让她的童年梦想成真。

ex.s: Pilots’ Dream Coming True.
ex.t: 飞行员的梦想成真。

ex.s: This insight grew from the determined attitude of a six-year-old boy who had the courage and perseverance to make his dream a reality.
ex.t: 这一感悟源于一个六岁男孩坚定的态度，他有勇气和毅力将梦想变为现实。

ex.s: You’ve made your dreams come true.
ex.t: 你实现了你的梦想。

ex.s: Lin even created an equation to explain this concept: Reality + Dreams + Humour = Wisdom.
ex.t: Lin甚至创造了一个等式来解释这个概念：现实+梦想+幽默=智慧。

ex.s: Those kids have dreams.
ex.t: 那些孩子都有梦想。

ex.s: The platform has enabled Ribeiro to realise her dream with a great deal of freedom, as ___50___ to a restaurant where the service is ___51___, the menu is known in advance, and the meal is expected to be no ___52___.
ex.t: 这个平台让Ribeiro能相当自由地实现她的梦想，___50___餐厅——在餐厅里服务是___51___的，菜单提前确定，饭菜预计不会有什么___52___。

ex.s: C her strong urge to follow the crowdD. her dream of entering a top university
ex.t: C 她随大流的强烈冲动D. 她进入顶尖大学的梦想

ex.s: Now, I’m living out that dream indirectly by helping the panda keepers do their job in English.
ex.t: 现在，我通过帮助熊猫饲养员用英语开展工作，间接实现了那个梦想。

ex.s: A childhood dream.
ex.t: 一个童年梦想。

ex.s: My first job was working at the Ukiah Library when I was 16 years old .It was a dream job and I did everything from shelving books to reading to the children for story time.
ex.t: 我的第一份工作是16岁时在尤凯亚图书馆工作。那是份梦想中的工作，从图书上架到故事时间给孩子们读书，我什么都做。

ex.s: It may be only a dream.
ex.t: 它可能只是一个梦想。

ex.s: Her childhood dream.
ex.t: 她童年的梦想。

ex.s: 6．（1分）﹣My son got a full scholarship to his dream university!
ex.t: 6．（1分）—我儿子拿到了梦想大学的全额奖学金！

ex.s: under my noseD. beyond my wildest dreams
ex.t: 他们甚至能分辨出母亲的声音和陌生女性的声音。

ex.s: School can keep those dreams alive by giving kids a way to learn and grow.”
ex.t: 学校能通过给孩子学习和成长的方式，让那些梦想保持鲜活。”

ex.s: Now, Cao has started the second part of his dream to walk along the Belt and Road route.
ex.t: 现在，曹已经开始了他梦想的第二部分——沿着一带一路路线行走。

ex.s: As I dreamt bigger, I began looking into college courses for Fashion Design and three months later I signed up for a part-time design course.
ex.t: 当我梦想更大的时候我开始关注大学里的时装设计课程三个月后我报名参加了一个兼职设计课程。

ex.s: Reality + Dreams + Humour = Wisdom 1 Work out the meaning of this equation.
ex.t: 现实 + 梦想 + 幽默 = 智慧 1 弄明白这个方程式的含义。

ex.s: A footballer dreaming of becoming a movie star.
ex.t: 一个梦想成为电影明星的足球运动员。

ex.s: Efforts in Science: Dreaming Big
ex.t: 科学努力：远大梦想

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Never let anyone tell you， "You can't．" Dream big and climb high！
ex.t: 永远别让任何人告诉你“你做不到”。大胆梦想，勇攀高峰！

ex.s: 21．（10分）Some people live to climb the highest mountains． Some people live only dreaming about it while others live to avoid ever climbing at all． But one thing is certain， all people encounter mountains in their life．
ex.t: 21．（10分）有些人活着是为了攀登最高的山峰。有些人只活在梦想里，而另一些人活着则完全避免去爬。但有一件事是确定的：所有人一生中都会遇到山。

ex.s: The boy replied with a ____48____ look, “Well, you are telling us to live our dreams when you haven’t even done it yourself.
ex.t: 男孩带着____48____的神情回答：“可是，你自己在都还没做到的情况下，却叫我们去追逐梦想。”

defs.def: a state of mind or a situation in which things do not seem real or part of normal life 梦幻状态；恍惚；出神
a beautiful or wonderful person or thing 梦一般美妙的人（或事物）；极美好的人（或事物）

ex.s: Building up a dream team is more complex than simply hiring the best talent.
ex.t: 组建梦之队比单纯雇佣最优秀的人才更复杂。

defs.def: to work very well 性能极佳；十分有效
to happen without problems, in the way that you had planned 毫无困难；非常顺利；完美
to experience a series of images, events and feelings in your mind while you are asleep 做梦

ex.s: Why do we dream？Scientists aren't completely sure,and they have diverse____11____ (idea)．Dreams might be a side effect of memory making.When you sleep,your brain sorts through everything ____12____ happened during the day，trying to link new experiences to old memories.As it ____13____ (connect) things，your brain tums them into a story,and you get a dream．
ex.t: 我们为什么会做梦？科学家也不完全确定，他们有各种各样的___11___（想法）。梦可能是记忆形成的副作用。当你睡觉时，大脑会梳理白天发生的每一件事___12___，试图把新经历和旧记忆联系起来。当它___13___（连接）事物时，大脑把它们变成了一个故事，于是你便做了个梦。

defs.def: to imagine and think about sth that you would like to happen 想像；梦想

ex.s: In 2013, I was determined to make my dream come true: I would become Australia's first professional photo blogger.
ex.t: 2013年，我决心让我的梦想成真：我要成为澳大利亚第一位专业的摄影博主。

ex.s: The possibility of self-driving robot cars has often seemed like a futurist’s dream, years away from materializing in the real world.
ex.t: 自动驾驶机器人汽车的可能性常常像一个未来主义者的梦想，似乎还要好多年才能在现实中出现。

ex.s: He wasn't mean or abusive; he just gave me the impression he could do whatever project we dreamed up better if he did it alone.
ex.t: 他不是恶毒或虐待;他只是给我一个印象,他可以做我们梦想中更好的项目,如果他单独做的话.
